lucy: quick Q — I need per-GPU SM% + KV cache evictions broken down by model for a prod canary. Want to correlate with batch size and memory pressure. Where do folks usually look?
ben: start in Grafana -> GPU Runtime space. Key panels: 'SM% by device' (panel uid: a1B2c3D4), 'KV cache evictions by model' (uid: e5F6g7H8). Direct: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/gpu-runtime (you can jump to a panel with ?viewPanel=<uid>).
ben: logs/traces live in Tempo/Jaeger and Loki. For traces use: https://traces.redwood.com/search?service=inference-runtime and filter tag `model=<your-model>`.
ben: example PromQL to compute eviction rate by model (5m):
```
sum by (model) (increase(kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) / sum by (model) (increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```
nora: re alerts — current evictions alert is noisy during autoscale. Proposal: adjust alert to two tiers: hosted (threshold 0.5% over 10m), dedicated/reserved (threshold 1.5% over 10m). Filed MR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/alerts/-/merge_requests/2345 with rationale and test graphs.
frank: also check `runtime.batch_size.p50` and `runtime.batch_size.p95` on the Request Metrics dashboard — batch spikes often line up with SM% drops.
lucy: good call, where is the Request Metrics dashboard?
ben: Grafana -> Request Metrics (space) or direct: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/request-metrics. Panel name: 'Batch size distribution' (uid: b9C8d7E6).
lucy: anyone have an example trace that shows `kvcache.evict` spans + OOMs? Trying to find a short window to share with the SREs.
ben: search traces for operation `kvcache.evict` and tag `level:warning` or `level:error`. Also in Loki: {"span.operation":"kvcache.evict"} with `| json` then look for `oom` in message.
